ablation_summary.key_finding: The DERIVATIVE term on the P_CSF - P_venous differential is LOAD-BEARING. Pure proportional differential (WO'847 equivalent) achieves only 30.8% M2 reduction — BELOW buyer-grade. Adding the derivative term (transient venous-state compensation) raises it to 69.3% — ABOVE buyer-grade. The derivative term adds +38.5 percentage points of over-drainage reduction.
